replacement_text: General packed/vector readers beyond the fixed profiles, arbitrary sparse subgroups and the authors' full optimized instruction registry remain unsupported software generality. The independent SiLU, weighted RMSNorm, seeded in-place fused add RMSNorm, native online attention, both native RoPE layouts, both fused QK/RoPE layouts, distinct FlashInfer RMSNorm, guarded packed SGLang RMSNorm and native FP16 single-split-K AWQ GEMM have complete source-bound actual-launch and actual-trace race-freedom proofs in their stated profiles. Their registered profiles publish 48 independent exports across nine accepted families; the real profiles also prove independent dense-reference equality. The original llm.c adaptation has an initialized race and complete one-row counterexample; its repair has whole-grid canonical-real correctness through a development checker and issues zero registered softmax certificates. SGLang's lane-zero repair is explicit. AWQ retains the paper's FP16-weight/single-split-K departures, with an independent AMD wave64 MFMA fragment mapping. These results do not reproduce the authors' original source registry, original model outcomes or NVIDIA measurements. IEEE/rounding error theorems remain outside the paper's formal claims.
